text: Fresh complete compose CSP hunk read. It adds resource: to script-src for the reported resource://devtools/server/startup/worker.js script; worker-src already permits resource: and is unchanged. Fixed compose policy retains resource: and has a separate later moz-src addition. The landing does not relax the other directives or establish a general scheme permission rule. The Bug qualifies the devtools-open precondition, uncertain impact, no automated coverage and no Beta verification; Daily verification is attributed. Review is brief approval, not a reproduced CSP/devtools or ordinary compose test. No console, native compose, worker, keyboard or security test ran.
title: Compose script CSP admits the reported devtools resource without changing worker-src
